# The review loop of examples/review-loop stops after three drafts when the reviewer never approves.
# The author sends three drafts and revises twice. The reviewer ends after its third verdict, and the author fails the run and names the cap.
isolate

example review-loop/workflow.star
example review-loop/project.star config/projects/review.star
example review-loop/prompts/draft.md
example review-loop/prompts/review.md
example review-loop/prompts/revise.md
reviewfakes

exec beehavereal item add review note-1 --title 'Release note' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run note-1 review --workflow review-loop/workflow.star
stderr 'the reviewer did not approve a draft in 3 rounds'

cmp calls.log expected-calls.log

-- body.txt --
Write the release note.
-- verdicts --
changes
changes
changes
-- expected-calls.log --
draft
review Draft 1.
revise Fix round 1.
review Draft 2.
revise Fix round 2.
review Draft 3.
